home.heroTitle: Lombok Souvenirs, Shipped to Your Door
home.heroSubtitle: Handwoven ikat, silver jewellery, tees and local delicacies from Senggigi. Order online, delivered across Indonesia.
home.featuredLead: The best of Lombok's local artisans and makers.
home.emptyCatalog: The catalog is being set up. Reach us on WhatsApp to place an order.
home.categoriesLead: From Sukarara handweaving to Sembalun robusta coffee.

why.storyBody: Weave motifs, silver origin, the maker's name — we write the provenance, because a souvenir is the story you carry home.
why.packBody: Bubble wrap, rigid boxes, seals — fragile pieces and textiles arrive intact even shipping across islands.
why.shipBody: We record accurate weight and dimensions per variant, so the shipping cost at checkout is the real one.

home.groupTitle: Bringing a bus group? Shopping can be ready before you arrive.
home.groupBody: Send the group's shopping plan and we pre-pack the packages. The bus arrives, the group just picks up — no 30-person queue at the till.
home.storyBody: Lombok Exotic grew from a small stall into West Lombok's go-to for souvenirs: textiles, silver, tees, local food, a cafe resto, and the Bajang Bus fleet for tour groups.
home.contactBody: Message us on WhatsApp — we can help source it, build custom hampers, or handle bulk orders.
